_about: Which TRUST building block each risk belongs to on the Risk site (owner, 15 Nov 2026). Display only: it changes no TRUST score. A risk is placed by its own ID in by_risk first, then by its domain in by_domain. Operational and Data risks are not placed by domain: Tech Risk places them risk by risk on the site (Edit, Each risk's building block), so by_risk starts empty. A risk placed by neither shows as Not placed yet. TEST uses tools/test_risks/risk_building_blocks.json.
